description: Draft concise, evidence-based one-to-one B2B outreach tailored to the recipient and context you provide.

defaultPrompt: Draft a concise first-touch B2B email from the recipient and offer details I provide.
Personalize this B2B email using only supplied facts and flag details I should verify.
Review this email for clarity, pressure, claims, opt-outs, and compliance questions to verify.
interface.longDescription: Draft concise one-to-one business outreach from facts you provide. The assistant helps clarify the audience and goal, personalize without inventing details, and review tone, clarity, and relevant compliance or sender-guideline questions. It does not scrape profiles, send or automate email, evade opt-outs, or provide legal guarantees.

name: cold-email-writer-personalizer
